title: NFSMW Setup JSON-line event
description: One object per stdout line with --events. Child output goes only to the run log. --check ends after preflight, pc, x360 with exit 0 and no done event; --build emits done only after verified transactional install. Stages in order: preflight, pc, x360, recompile, tables, audio, shaders, ffmpeg, runtime, assets, bundle, install. Audio builds its FFmpeg prerequisite before compiling media.cpp. Cancellation exits 130; every other failed stage exits nonzero. work/run-log.txt contains the current log path. Environment overrides: NFSMW_SETUP_HOME (state/logs/cache/data beneath it), NFSMW_SETUP_STATE, NFSMW_SETUP_LOGS, NFSMW_SETUP_CACHE, NFSMW_SETUP_DATA, NFSMW_SETUP_LEGACY (the 3.x profile whose career saves install copies into a 4.0 profile without saves; warn event on copy or refusal). --check logs only in work/logs. setup.sh uses TOOLS_PY, else deps/python/bin/python3, python/bin/python3 or .venv/bin/python3 in the payload. Public bundle: NFS Most Wanted Native.app (executable NFSMostWanted; an existing 3.x app there is renamed NFS Most Wanted Native 3.x.app and kept); io.github.nfsmw-native-mac; version 4.0.0.
